name: I'm Okay
source:
I know how you feel. I know this feeling. Of not truly feeling like yourself. But 2047. Something terrible will happen. You have to find out.

[From [url=https://burnagangson.itch.io/im-okay-epi-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我知道你的感受。我知道那种感觉：觉得自己并不是真正的自己。可是，2047年会发生可怕的事情。你必须查明真相。

[摘自[url=https://burnagangson.itch.io/im-okay-epi-1]Itch.io[/url]]
